q1: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)
q2: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE CUSTOMERS.ID != ALL (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE CUSTOMERS.ID != ALL (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)
explanation: Both Q1 and Q2 are designed to find customers who have not made any orders. They achieve this by checking if the customer ID does not exist in the ORDERS table. The NOT IN and != ALL subqueries are semantically equivalent in this context.
